en: Walk the opening directives: ration, maintenance, then radio. Each choice has a cost.
Open the shelter and inspect rooms until three have confirming notes.
Open the stores and read them
Open the inventory and look at the food and water you are rationing.
Assign a survivor to a duty
Open the duty roster and assign one survivor to a shift. Survivors cannot work without one.
Open the weather forecast or panel to learn what tomorrow will bring.
Use an item from the stores
Equip a protective item or consume something real from the ledger. Both are real commands.
Press the Advance Day confirm. The first night ticks; the morning briefing returns.
ACUTE RADIATION DETECTED: Survivor {0} has {1:F0} mSv exposure (-5 HP/h decay). Administer Rad-Away or Iodine.
FALLOUT STORM INCOMING: Elevated environmental radiation. Keep survivors indoors or equip hazmat gear.
WATER RESERVES LOW: {0:F1} units remaining (~{1:F1} days). Run filtration or desalination.
FOOD RESERVES LOW: {0:F1} units remaining (~{1:F1} days). Adjust rations or scavenge.
POWER DEFICIT: Generator reserve depleted. Air filtration offline; indoor contamination rising.
SURVIVOR IN DANGER: {0} has reached critical {1}. Triage immediately.
Radiation & Dosimeter: Dose accumulates from fallout and storms. Above 50 mSv triggers acute radiation sickness with 5 HP/hr health decay. Administer Rad-Away or Iodine.
Rations & Water: Clean water is essential. 3 survivors consume ~3.6 units daily. Maintain filtration membranes.
Power & Grid: Air filtration requires continuous electrical power. Stock batteries and generator fuel.
Duty Shifts: Unassigned survivors suffer morale decay and cannot maintain bunker facilities.
